.²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a sage.
.²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a country in the south; {#taTASmakAH pulindASca kaliNgASca viSezataH#}
 <ls>Rām.</ls> (probably an old name of Travancore); according to <ls>Bṛ. S. 14. 22</ls>
 it is in the north-west ({#diSi paScimottarasyAM … aSmakakulUtalahaqastrIrAjyanfsiMhavanaKasTAH#})
.²3 The inhabitants of the country (<ab>pl.</ab>).
.²4 A part of the {#sAlva#} country or its inhabitants; or its king.
